findings.text: follow-on: the plan names the db_pdcattable store for the EDDB category comparison while the fragment documents the substitution with the eddbreadCatTable public API, so the raw table was not read as the deliverable asked.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit 71b25ea..4b6dad10 against base 223593c2; the scanner, both remote scripts, the config and the test file carry the change with the EDDB id construction unchanged.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when requires each of UDDB/PMDB/LCDB/MBDB/EQDB to carry FacilitySignals or a recorded attempt with call and return code; the fragment's attempt table records UDDB 188 landed, LCDB 8,469 landed, PMDB plantdread/planthread 301, MBDB mbdbROpen 1012, EQDB scandir 2, and the head gate run records 18 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: §39 asks the EDAS scanner to land FacilitySignals from every JT-60SA EDAS database; imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/edas.py:191-268 adds UDDB, LCDB and MBDB branches to the existing EDASScanner and jt-60sa.yaml:44 extends data_systems.edas with the database list and wrapper paths, so no parallel scanner is added and the EDDB branch (edas.py:270-300) is untouched.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate command with absolute paths and EXIT=0 with 18 passed, a baseline_suite/after_suite pair (baseline.log exit 1, head-absolute.log exit 0), a negative control, and the live-landing/live-check logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares the scanner, enumerate_edas.py, check_edas.py, tests/discovery/test_edas_scanner.py, the evidence fragment, a figures directory and jt-60sa.yaml; git diff --stat against the base touches exactly six files, all inside that set.

justifications.durability: the recorded negative control (negative-control.log) mutates enumerate_uddb to return no rows and fails tests/discovery/test_edas_scanner.py::TestConfiguredDatabases::test_uddb_table_rows_are_emitted with EXIT=1, but the MBDB name-extraction path at enumerate_edas.py:473 runs live only through the stubbed test.
justifications.evidence: the head gate tests/discovery/test_edas_scanner.py exits 0 with 18 passed and the live logs (live-enumeration-final.log, live-check-lcdb.log, live-check-uddb.log) record the counts, but the plan's db_pdcattable comparison was substituted with the eddbreadCatTable public API, as all-edas-databases.html:18 states.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/remote/scripts/enumerate_edas.py:254 follows the module's existing per-database helper idiom and the added symbols (_lcdb_categories, _mbdb_data_names, attempt_database) carry no plan label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/edas.py:196 emits UDDB/LCDB/MBDB signals via the existing EDASScanner and the plan's "do not add a parallel scanner" holds, since the EDDB identity path at edas.py:270 is unchanged.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing EDASScanner and its remote scripts, and a search over imas_codex and tests for lcdb/mbdb/uddb/pmdb owners found only the scanner's own scripts and jt-60sa.yaml, so no capability was forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 223593c2..4b6dad10 touches only the scanner, the two remote scripts, jt-60sa.yaml, tests/discovery/test_edas_scanner.py and the evidence fragment, every one inside the manifest's declared write paths.
